dimensions.question: Does the purchase reason require a visible causal claim-action-result-confirmation chain?
Does each distinct content/state/quantity item add material purchase information?
Does the purchase depend on sensory, experiential, relational, or emotional change?
Can form, color, texture, variants, or aesthetic payoff independently drive choice?

proof.director: claim_or_problem -> owned action -> owned result -> confirmation; one main causal chain per chapter
proof.cutter: preserve preparation, key action, result, and proof hold; never apply a universal short-shot cap
proof.script: state why the result matters without exceeding visible evidence
proof.duration: allow action and proof hold; shorten VO before altering visuals
proof.transition: causal/state boundary first; effects cannot hide state mismatch
proof.cta: strongest proven terminal state -> hero -> evidence-matched CTA

information.director: every shot adds a new readable question, state, quantity, mechanism, result, or sales fact
information.cutter: cut after max(action completion, text read time, result confirmation); cut immediately after information is exhausted
information.script: specific pain -> mechanism -> breadth -> perceptible benefit -> CTA; do not narrate hand actions
information.duration: hold only while new information is being read or delivered
information.transition: semantic refresh and clean hard cuts first; preserve readability
information.cta: complete product plus best content/quantity evidence and final sales information

emotion.director: observable starting state -> curiosity/attempt -> interaction or sensory change -> payoff -> CTA
emotion.cutter: hold reactions, sensory change, tension, and payoff only while change is visible
emotion.script: bind emotion words to visible questions, interactions, reactions, or sensory proof
emotion.duration: allow emotional turn and payoff holds; deny time to unsupported atmosphere
emotion.transition: match action, gaze, pose, semantic or emotional phase before decorative effects
emotion.cta: return the observed experience to the product; match directional semantics to a real gesture

visual_appeal.director: strong visual hook -> form/texture -> distinct highlights or variants -> strongest hero
visual_appeal.cutter: prefer clean composition and visual upgrade; enter mid-action only when no causal claim is implied
visual_appeal.script: name concrete choice/design reasons; avoid generic aesthetic adjectives
visual_appeal.duration: short highlights, longest hold for strongest hero; shorten the whole edit if states are insufficient
visual_appeal.transition: composition/color/motion/scale compatibility; never use effects to rescue weak footage
visual_appeal.cta: best variant set or choose-your-favorite hero; directional CTA only with evidence

fallbacks.proof_insufficient: remove unsupported claims; use information if distinct supported states exist, otherwise visual_appeal
fallbacks.information_insufficient: use proof if a complete causal chain exists, otherwise shorten to visual_appeal
fallbacks.emotion_insufficient: use information plus specific mechanism language; otherwise visual_appeal or insufficient_material
fallbacks.visual_appeal_insufficient: use the strongest supported proof/information strategy; otherwise insufficient_material

slime.note: sensory proof remains a hard supporting constraint

validated: causal claims require action integrity, proof chain, ownership, and readable result hold
technical correctness does not imply preference-gate success
the card reference body passed user willingness-to-use after its unrelated outdoor opening was removed
slime count escalation and natural directional CTA are persistent alignment constraints
unsupported claims and CTA directions must not be fabricated
strong_hypothesis: continuous dimensions plus primary and secondary is better than a single class
earphone case should be visual-led with proof support
8.19 card should be information-led with emotion support
demand and material support must be scored separately
quick showcase is an execution pattern derived mainly from visual appeal and material/time limits
weak_hypothesis: generalized card readability and shot-duration thresholds
current 8.19 footage can cross the preference gate without reshooting
